native_context: iOS Keychain item accessibility and sharing authority
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: iOS Keychain item accessibility and sharing authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect item class/accessibility/access-control attributes, query keys, signed access-group entitlements and account lifecycle. Establish required locked/background/recovery behavior.
controls.controlled_verification: Use synthetic items in owned signed test apps/device states. Compare intended retrieval with the prohibited app/account/lock state and record which query/access group selected the item. Simulator or modified-device results retain those prerequisites.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A shared group or item surviving uninstall is not automatically disclosure. A UI lock is different from Keychain access control, and source entitlement text is not proof of signed release entitlements.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use appropriate platform attributes and narrow group/account queries while preserving required background/recovery flows. Retest lock states, account switch and authorized sharing.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
